note: Elevator Express V0.1 (D189): an arcade delivery route. Only the four decisions are evidence (the floor, the place, the cell); driving, steering, bumps, bolts and throws never are. Street notes are checked against the street order.

lines.intro: Deliver elevator parts across town! UP and DOWN to steer. THROW at a glowing door.
lines.moveUp: The crew is on floor {start}. The stuck elevator is {change} floors up. Which floor?
lines.moveDown: The crew is on floor {start}. The stuck elevator is {change} floors down. Which floor?
lines.power: This elevator needs {needed} power. It has {present}. Which cell fills it?
lines.pickPlace: Tap the building on the street.
lines.packedFloor: Kit for floor {value}! Throw it at the glowing door.
lines.packedPlace: Got it! Throw it at the {place}.
lines.packedCell: Power cell packed! Throw it at the glowing door.
lines.wrongFloor: Not that floor. Count again from {start}.
lines.wrongPlace: Not that one. Read the note again.
lines.wrongCell: That cell does not fill the gap. Look again.
lines.fresh: New job! Take a fresh look.
lines.ladderFloor: Count the floors one by one.
lines.showMe: Here it is. Tap the shining one.
lines.missed: Missed! The helper robot brings it back. Try again.

after-hospital.text: Bring the brake sensor to the building right after the hospital.

after-school.text: Drop the door motor at the building right after the school.

between-library-bakery.text: Deliver the cable reel to the building between the library and the bakery.
between-library-bakery.key: between the library and the bakery

before-hospital.text: Take the button panel to the building just before the hospital.
